overview.description: The Roundhill Ultra Short Duration No Dividend Target ETF (XBOX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long/short alternatives. The fund is an actively managed ETF that seeks short-duration, fixed income-like returns using a market neutral options strategy. The fund invests in box spreads to access short-term financing rates while aiming to minimize taxable distributions. XBOX was launched on Mar 18, 2026 and is issued by Roundhill.
